dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 06, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Wild Wednesday: Several Teams Go Off the Rails**

In a day filled with blowouts and comebacks, the Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 15-1 behind a team effort with multiple players contributing to the rout. Tyler Tolbert led the charge with five hits, including a home run and two RBIs. Noah Cameron earned the win with a strong start, striking out seven in five innings of work.

On the other end of the spectrum, the New York Yankees cruised past the Tampa Bay Rays 5-1 behind Cam Schlittler's eight innings of one-run ball. José Caballero was the top bat for the Yankees, going 2-for-3 with two home runs and four RBIs. His teammate, Ben Rice, also went deep with his 25th home run of the season.

In a back-and-forth battle, the Washington Nationals outlasted the Houston Astros 11-12 in a game that saw several players shine. CJ Abrams led the Nationals with three hits, including a home run and three RBIs, while Miles Mikolas earned the win in relief.

Other notable performances came from the Arizona Diamondbacks, who blanked the San Diego Padres 8-0 behind Brandon Pfaadt's five shutout innings. Nolan Arenado was the top bat for Arizona, going 1-for-4 with a home run. The San Francisco Giants also cruised, defeating the Toronto Blue Jays 10-1 behind Landen Roupp's eight innings of one-run ball. Heliot Ramos led the Giants with three hits, including two home runs and five RBIs.
